title: Program Manager
jobDescription:
ROLE:
As a Program Manager at Droom, you will be at the forefront of driving strategic initiatives and organization wide programs that are critical to the success and growth of our business. You will play a pivotal role in leading cross-functional teams and ensuring the successful execution and delivery of key projects and initiatives. Your primary responsibility will be to oversee the planning, implementation, and management of programs from conception to completion, while ensuring alignment with organizational goals and objectives. Candidates with an MBA from Ivy League colleges such as IIMs, ISB, or similar prestigious institutions, are highly encouraged to apply. Analytical mindset, and domain knowledge in E-Commerce, automobile, and tech sectors are essential.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
You will be responsible for leading the planning, execution, and delivery of strategic programs and initiatives that are essential to achieving Droom's business objectives. This involves working closely with senior leadership and key stakeholders to define program scope, objectives, and success criteria. Collaboration is key to success at Droom. You will collaborate closely with various departments, including product management, engineering, marketing, sales, and operations, to drive alignment and ensure seamless coordination throughout the program lifecycle. You will develop detailed project plans, timelines, and resource allocation to ensure the successful execution of programs within scope, schedule, and budget constraints. You will establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics to measure program performance and progress. Regularly monitoring and reporting on these metrics will enable you to track program effectiveness and make data-driven decisions to drive continuous improvement. Proactively identifying potential risks, issues, and dependencies that may impact program delivery is crucial. Effective communication is essential for program success. You will serve as a primary point of contact for program-related communication, providing regular updates, status reports, and presentations to stakeholders at all levels of the organization. Requirements: MBA from Ivy League colleges such as IIMs, ISB, or similar prestigious institutions is highly preferred. Proven experience (1-2 years) in program management or project management roles, preferably in the technology or e-commerce industry. Strong analytical mindset with the ability to think strategically and solve complex problems. Domain knowledge in e-commerce, automobile, and tech sectors is essential, with a deep understanding of industry trends, challenges, and opportunities. Ability to lead cross-functional teams, drive consensus, and achieve results in a matrixed organization. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. Experience with agile development methodologies is a plus. Project management certifications such as PMP, Pg MP, or similar are desirable.

title: BTL Specialist
jobDescription:

Droom, India's leading online marketplace for buying and selling cars, is searching for a rockstar BTL (Below-the-Line) specialist to join our growing team. In this role, you'll be the go-to person for all things BTL, ensuring Droom makes a lasting impression both on and offline.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

From dealer meets to roadshows and industry conferences, you'll be the mastermind behind it all. Merchandising Maestro: Develop and manage a killer Droom merchandise line. Think t- shirts, phone cases, keychains, and anything else that lets car enthusiasts show their Droom pride! Branding Boss: Oversee Droom's brand identity across all BTL activities. Is a team player with a creative and results-oriented mindset.

title: Dealer Marketing Manager

We are seeking a passionate and results-oriented Dealer Community Manager to join our growing team! You will play a pivotal role in building and nurturing relationships with our dealer network, driving dealer acquisition, engagement, and overall satisfaction.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Content Management: Own and maintain content for Droom's dealer-facing webpages including lead forms, tracking, and overall user experience. Spearhead the creation and curation of content for Droom University. Continuously update and refresh existing Droom University content to ensure its relevance and effectiveness. Dealer Communication & Engagement: Manage and execute a bi-monthly dealer newsletter, including template design, email blast, performance analysis, and follow-up actions. Develop and implement communication strategies to keep dealers informed of news, updates, announcements, and policy changes. Oversee all dealer marketing and acquisition Go-To-Market (GTM) materials. Dealer Acquisition & Growth: Implement strategies to generate new dealer signups and new active dealers per month. Spearhead Chairman Club subscriber acquisition. Dealer Training & Development: Organize and conduct weekly training programs focusing on dealer success and platform utilization. Host regular dealer webinars on various topics relevant to the automotive industry. Dealer Relationship Management: Manage monthly dealer store branding and visual retail merchandising based on subscription tiers. Facilitate the collection of dealer testimonials. Conduct weekly dealer meets to foster open communication and address concerns. Organize and execute dealer roadshows to strengthen regional dealer connections. Plan and execute large-scale dealer summits to drive industry knowledge sharing and networking. Facilitate meetings between top-performing dealers and Droom's leadership team. Dealer Experience & Optimization: Conduct audits of dealer branding, particularly for resellers, to ensure brand consistency. Lead focus group studies with dealers to gather valuable feedback on products and offerings. Maintain and update a comprehensive store branding and visual retail merchandising catalog for dealers. Implement strategies to enhance dealer Net Promoter Score (NPS) and Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) on a monthly basis. Benchmarking & Best Practices: Conduct research and analysis to identify industry best practices in dealer community management, benchmarking Droom's approach against leading platforms like Amazon, Flipkart, Alibaba, Temu, Zomato, Swiggy, Airbnb, and Uber. Experience managing and executing events (conferences, roadshows, etc.) is a plus. Data-driven approach with experience in marketing analytics and reporting. Passion for the automotive industry is a plus.

Update training curriculum regularly to reflect changes in processes, products, and market dynamics. title: Social Media Marketing Manager
jobDescription:
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Droom isn't your average car company, and neither should our social media be! We're looking for a creative wordsmith with the social media savvy of a cheetah on Red Bull to join our growing team. Basically, you'll be the: Meme Master: Crafting hilarious car-themed memes that will have our audience hitting that like button faster than a Tesla on Ludicrous Mode. Content Connoisseur: Cooking up engaging content that goes beyond just car specs. Think carpool karaoke challenges, quirky car hacks, and maybe even a dog dressed as a tire (don't judge, it will be cool). Trend Tracker: You'll sniff out the hottest social media trends quicker than a bloodhound on a scent and weave them into our content like a master weaver (of awesomeness). Community Catalyst: Sparking conversations, answering questions, and making our followers feel like they're part of the coolest car club ever (because they are!). Data Decoder: You won't be scared to dive into the social media analytics and use the insights to make our content even more epic-er. But wait, there's more! You'll also be working closely with our design team to create killer visuals that ensure brand consistency across all our social media channels. We're big on measuring success, so you'll be whipping up regular reports to evaluate the impact of our social media initiatives. And that's not all! We need you to: Develop a treasure trove of creative content and display ads that perfectly capture our brand message. Be a brainstorming pro, assisting in all aspects of brand-related projects, from concept to execution, research, promotion, and reporting. Build strong relationships with online communities and bloggers to expand our reach. Oversee the design of everything from Facebook cover photos and profile pics to thumbnails, ads, landing pages, Twitter profiles, and even blog visuals. Because results matter: You'll be compiling reports for management that showcase the return on investment (ROI) of our social media efforts. Be a brand champion: Become an advocate for Droom in social media spaces, engaging in conversations and answering questions with confidence. Show us your strategic chops: Demonstrate your ability to map out winning social media marketing strategies, test different approaches, and measure results for continuous improvement. Customer feedback matters: Develop a system to capture valuable customer reviews online and monitor online ratings, responding accordingly. Stay ahead of the curve: Continuously monitor trends in social media tools, apps, channels, design, and strategy. This is your chance to become a social media guru! Identify and address potential issues: Keep an eye out for user-generated content related to Droom, identifying both threats and opportunities. We'll work together to address any concerns. Learn from experience: Analyze past social media campaigns, translating feedback and data into actionable plans for future success. Become a social media metrics master: Stay on top of the latest industry benchmarks for measuring the impact of social media campaigns. You'll be analyzing, reviewing, and reporting on effectiveness to maximize results. Bonus Points if you: Can quote movie car chase scenes with frightening accuracy. Have a hidden talent for car origami (folding car instructions out of paper, not actual origami cars...yet). Can hold a conversation about the best way to parallel park (because let's be honest, it's a skill). The Perks (because everyone deserves a reward for being awesome): Be part of a team that's as passionate about cars as you are (and maybe a little more obsessed, but we won't judge). Free reign to unleash your creativity and make social media magic happen. Competitive salary and benefits to fuel your car-loving lifestyle (because gas ain't cheap these days). Snacks. Glorious, glorious snacks. (We take snack time seriously here.) So, if you're ready to ditch the boring social media posts and join a team that's all about having fun while making a splash in the auto industry, hit that apply button! We can't wait to meet you.

title: Associate Director/Director SEO
jobDescription:
ROLE:
The Senior Director of SEO at Droom will lead the development and execution of comprehensive SEO strategies to drive organic growth. This role involves ensuring crawlability, optimizing site structure and URLs, enhancing page speed and mobile-friendliness, securing the site with HTTPS, implementing structured data, and managing internal linking and canonicalization. Responsibilities also include indexation management, handling 404 errors and redirects, optimizing meta tags and HTML markup, and conducting regular site audits and monitoring. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in technical SEO, strong analytical skills, and the ability to advocate for SEO best practices within the organization.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Develop and implement comprehensive SEO strategies that align with Droom’s business goals. Analyze and interpret SEO trends to ensure Droom remains at the forefront of search engine algorithms and best practices. Oversee the technical SEO strategy, ensuring optimal site structure, performance, and accessibility. Conduct thorough site audits to identify and rectify technical issues such as crawl errors, broken links, duplicate content, and page speed issues. Implement structured data, schema markup, and other advanced technical SEO tactics. Oversee the technical SEO strategy, ensuring optimal site structure, performance, and accessibility. Conduct thorough site audits to identify and rectify technical issues such as crawl errors, broken links, duplicate content, and page speed issues. Implement structured data, schema markup, and other advanced technical SEO tactics. Collaborate with web developers to ensure SEO best practices are properly implemented on newly developed code. Manage XML sitemaps, robots.txt, and URL parameters for efficient search engine crawling. Ensure the website is fully responsive and optimized for mobile devices. Secure the website with HTTPS and ensure all pages and resources are served over a secure connection. Use canonical tags to prevent duplicate content issues and manage URL parameters. Handle 404 errors properly with custom error pages and implement 301 redirects for moved or deleted pages. Optimize title tags, meta descriptions, header tags, and HTML markup for relevance and keyword usage. Conduct regular site audits to identify and fix technical issues. Monitor site health, crawl errors, and other technical SEO aspects using tools like Google Search Console and third-party SEO tools. Conduct keyword research to guide content development and optimize existing content. Utilize analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Google Search Console etc.) to monitor, analyze, and report on SEO performance. Provide actionable insights and recommendations to senior management based on data analysis. Work closely with marketing, product, engineering, and data teams to ensure SEO best practices are integrated across all channels and platforms. Advocate for SEO within the organization, promoting awareness and understanding of its impact. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Computer Science, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred. 10+ years of experience in SEO with a proven track record of driving organic growth. In-depth knowledge of search engine algorithms, ranking factors, and SEO best practices. Proficient with SEO tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Moz, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog). Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret data to make informed decisions. Excellent project management and organizational skills. Proven experience in managing and developing a team. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously. Experience with large-scale websites and e-commerce platforms is highly desirable.
